items.heading: Ema Datshi
details: Key ingredients: green chilies, cheese, tomato, onion
Slice a generous amount of green chilies lengthwise.
Simmer the chilies with tomato and onion in a little water.
Add cheese and stir until melted into a thick sauce.
Serve hot over steamed red rice.

items.heading: Phaksha Paa
details: Key ingredients: pork, radish, dried chilies, ginger
Simmer pork belly slices with sliced radish and ginger.
Add dried whole chilies for a smoky heat.
Cook until the pork is tender and the radish has softened.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

items.heading: Jasha Maru
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Momos
details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt, filling of vegetables or meat, aromatics and dipping sauce.
Make a pliable dough, roll thin, fill and seal.
Steam or boil until cooked; serve with a seasoned sauce.

items.heading: Red Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.
